description: Données de transport en commun réseau Altigo - Communauté de Communes du Briançonnais - Format GTFS is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes du Briançonnais. The public transport network of the Community of Communes of Briançonnais, known as Altigo, has been active since 1 November 2022. However, several structuring steps will be taken during 2023 to achieve a full roll-out of the Community transport network by 1 September 2023. Coverage: Communauté de Communes du Briançonnais. The portal shows the English title as "Data of transit network Altigo - Community of Communes of Briançonnais - Format GTFS" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes du Briançonnais. Its keywords include mobilite, gtfs, transport-en-commun. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-07-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
